name: Ops.Extension.Standalone.MacOs.ShortcutsCli
summary: Run a macOS Shortcut asynchronously via the shortcuts CLI with optional JSON stdin payload and stdout capture.

ports.name: Shortcut Name
ports.text: The name or UUID identifier of the macOS Shortcut to run.

ports.name: Input Payload
ports.text: Optional object payload serialized as JSON and passed to the shortcut via standard input.

ports.name: Execute
ports.text: Trigger this port to run the shortcut in a non-blocking child process.

ports.name: Completed
ports.text: Triggered when the shortcut process finishes.

ports.name: Stdout
ports.text: The standard output returned by the shortcut.

ports.name: Stderr
ports.text: The standard error output from the shortcuts CLI.

ports.name: JSON Output
ports.text: If Stdout is valid JSON, it is parsed and output here as an object.

ports.name: Exit Code
ports.text: The exit code of the shortcuts process (0 on success).

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True while the shortcut child process is currently running.

ports.name: Error
ports.text: Triggered if the shortcuts process fails or returns a non-zero exit code.
